introductionText: At Mr. Bills, your privacy is very important to us and we are committed to protecting the personal information you share with us. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your data when using the Mr. Bills app.
personalInfo: Personal Information: Name, email, and any other details you enter in the app.
noDeviceInfo: We do not collect any device-related information or usage data.
provideServices: To provide and manage app services (bill creation, reminders, payment tracking).
communicateUpdates: To communicate with you about updates, notifications, and important app-related information.
improveFunctionality: To improve app functionality and performance based on user feedback.
legalCompliance: To comply with legal and regulatory requirements.
dataStorageSecurityText: Your data is securely stored on our servers, and we take appropriate measures to protect it from unauthorized access, alteration, or deletion. We do not share or sell your personal data to third parties for marketing purposes. We may share your information with trusted service providers who assist in app functions such as payment processing.
serviceProviders: Service Providers: We may share your information with trusted partners who help operate the app, such as payment gateways or cloud storage providers.
legalComplianceSharing: Legal Compliance: We may disclose your information if required by law or in response to legal requests such as subpoenas or court orders.
accessCorrection: Access & Correction: You can access and correct your personal data at any time within the app.
dataDeletion: Data Deletion: You can request to delete your account and any associated data via the in-app support service. Please note that once your data is deleted, it cannot be restored.
subscriptionPricingText: We reserve the right to increase the prices of any available subscription plans. You will be notified at least one week before new prices take effect via email or app notifications.
ageRestrictionText: This app is not intended for children under 13 years old. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under this age.
internationalStorageText: Your data may be stored and processed in countries outside your country of residence.
policyUpdatesText: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be clarified here and the effective date will be updated. Continuing to use the app after any update means you accept the revised policy.
liabilityDisclaimerText: We are not responsible for any misuse of personal data by third parties as long as we comply with this policy and applicable laws.
cookiesTrackingText: Currently, we do not collect usage data or track users. If we implement analytics, cookies, or tracking in the future, we will update this policy.
contactUsText: If you have any questions or inquiries about the privacy policy or how we handle your data, please contact us:
consentText: By using the Mr. Bills app, you consent to the collection and use of your information as described in this privacy policy.
